dag_topology.mandatory_connectivity: every non-source task has a predecessor in the previous layer and every non-sink task has a successor in the next layer
dag_topology.validation: networkx DAG check + topological_sort + topological_generations + max layer jump == 1 + weak connectivity

deadline_method.reference_policy: HEFT-like upward-rank ready-task order + earliest-finish gang placement

m_i_distribution.finite_dag_sampling: largest-remainder integer quotas followed by seeded shuffle; avoids accidental omission of rare m_i classes
m_i_distribution.name: shifted_symmetric_binomial_n5_p0.5

raw_timing.note: Values stored in legacy '*_sec' fields are canonical simulation seconds, not measured wall-clock seconds. A single common scale preserves all A7/A12 runtime ratios. Supply --sample-interval-sec only when the real acquisition period is known and verified.
raw_timing.raw_index_semantics: # is validated as contiguous sample counter 1..N and is never interpreted directly as elapsed seconds
raw_timing.reference_statistic: median max-VF raw sample count across matched profiles
raw_timing.source: derived only from raw trace sample counts; no acquisition-period assumption
raw_timing.training_scale_note: One common time scale is used for every task and both processors. Therefore A7/A12 timing ratios and all DAG scheduling relationships are preserved. The legacy environment subsequently normalizes time/energy features before they enter GAT/PPO.
